cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a tropical juice stand — a bamboo counter, baskets of fruit, a blender, paper umbrellas and a palm-leaf awning
cuts.scene: she is the stand owner standing with her hands folded behind the bamboo counter, cheerfully waiting under the palm-leaf awning
cuts.outfit: a juice stand owner look fitted to her body — a short Hawaiian-style apron over a halter top and short shorts with sandals, bare shoulders and legs, a palm-leaf hairpin and shell necklace
